title: Access Node
summary: A narrow corridor splits into a junction where a single console dominates the left wall, flanked by a locked cabinet and a flickering intercom panel.
arrival_narration: The airlock’s inner door hisses shut behind you. A dimly lit corridor stretches ahead, its walls lined with exposed conduit. To the left, a **console** hums faintly, its screen displaying a single red light. A **locked cabinet** stands beside it, its handle cold to the touch. A **wall-mounted intercom panel** crackles with static, its buttons unmarked. The corridor splits—one path continues straight, the other veers right into a shadowed alcove.
